LEGAL & REGULATORY NOTICE: This tabletop kit and forensic verification cockpit is engineered in strict adherence to EU Regulation 2022/2554 (Digital Operational Resilience Act — DORA), Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/2956, and Joint ESAs Technical Standards on Incident Classification (Articles 18, 19, and 24).

This engine functions strictly in a non-custodial, deterministic verification capacity. Cryptographic proofs (SHA-256 Merkle hash-chaining, RFC 8785 canonicalization, and Ed25519 dual-control authorizations) are computed client-side within the local browser runtime without external network transmission. All simulations and receipts are verifiable off-chain and offline.
